cases.name: 飛水峡

exactBlockers.finding: Prefectural gateway is JR Kami-Asou. The municipal interchange 上麻生駅 is named but has no exact licensed P11 identity; national named scan has no locality-qualified bus record. Shirakawa pocket-park guidance specifies road access, not Shirakawaguchi station. No official passenger ferry or aerial gateway to this gorge was established.
exactBlockers.requiredExternalChange: Municipality must publish reusable exact station-bus identity; tourism publisher must explicitly validate any additional gorge gateway. A railway signal box is not a tourist station; the Shirakawa viewpoint is not automatically the same entrance.
